theorem iran1998_p9
    (x y z : ℝ)
    (hx : 1 < x)
    (hy : 1 < y)
    (hz : 1 < z)

    √(x - 1) + √(y - 1) + √(z - 1) ≤ √(x + y + z) := by 
  have h₁ : 0 < x - 1 := by linarith
  have h₂ : 0 < y - 1 := by linarith
  have h₃ : 0 < z - 1 := by linarith
  have h₄ : 0 < x + y + z := by linarith
  have h₅ : 0 < Real.sqrt (x - 1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h₁
  have h₆ : 0 < Real.sqrt (y - 1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h₂
  have h₇ : 0 < Real.sqrt (z - 1) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h₃
  have h₈ : 0 < Real.sqrt (x + y + z) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  set a := Real.sqrt (x - 1) with ha
  set b := Real.sqrt (y - 1) with hb
  set c := Real.sqrt (z - 1) with hc
  have h₉ : x = a^2 + 1 := by
    have h₉₁ : a ^ 2 = x - 1 := by
      rw [ha]
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ x - 1)]
    linarith
  
  have h₁₀ : y = b^2 + 1 := by
    have h₁₀₁ : b ^ 2 = y - 1 := by
      rw [hb]
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ y - 1)]
    linarith
  
  have h₁₁ : z = c^2 + 1 := by
    have h₁₁₁ : c ^ 2 = z - 1 := by
      rw [hc]
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ z - 1)]
    linarith
  
  have h₁₂ : 1 / (a^2 + 1) + 1 / (b^2 + 1) + 1 / (c^2 + 1) = 2 := by
    rw [h₉, h₁₀, h₁₁] at h
    ring_nf at h ⊢
    field_simp at h ⊢
    nlinarith [mul_pos h₁ h₂, mul_pos h₁ h₃, mul_pos h₂ h₃,
      mul_pos (mul_pos h₁ h₂) h₃]
  
  have h₁₃ : 2 * (a * b + b * c + c * a) ≤ 3 := by
    have h₁₃₁ : 0 < a := by
      exact h₅
    have h₁₃₂ : 0 < b := by
      exact h₆
    have h₁₃₃ : 0 < c := by
      exact h₇
    have h₁₃₄ : 0 < a * b := by positivity
    have h₁₃₅ : 0 < b * c := by positivity
    have h₁₃₆ : 0 < c * a := by positivity
    
    have h₁₃₇ : a * b + b * c + c * a ≤ 3 / 2 := by
      
      field_simp [add_assoc] at h₁₂
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a),
        sq_nonneg (a * b - 1 / 2), sq_nonneg (b * c - 1 / 2), sq_nonneg (c * a - 1 / 2),
        sq_nonneg (a * b + b * c + c * a - 3 / 2)]
    
    linarith
  
  have h₁₄ : (a + b + c)^2 ≤ a^2 + b^2 + c^2 + 3 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a), h₁₃]
  
  have h₁₅ : a + b + c ≤ Real.sqrt (a^2 + b^2 + c^2 + 3) := by
    apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
    nlinarith

    have h₁₆₁ : Real.sqrt (x + y + z) = Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + 3) := by
      rw [h₉, h₁₀, h₁₁]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [add_assoc]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ x - 1 by linarith), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ y - 1 by linarith),
        Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ z - 1 by linarith)]
    rw [h₁₆₁]
    exact h₁₅
  
  have h₁₇ : Real.sqrt (x - 1) + Real.sqrt (y - 1) + Real.sqrt (z - 1) ≤ Real.sqrt (x + y + z) := by
    simpa [ha, hb, hc] using h₁₆
  
  exact h₁₇

  intro a b c ha hb hc
  have h_main : 3 * (a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c) ≥ (a + b + c) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
    have h₁ : 0 ≤ (a - b) * (Real.log a - Real.log b) := by
      
      have h₁ : 0 ≤ (a - b) * (Real.log a - Real.log b) := by
        by_cases h : a ≥ b
        · 
          have h₂ : Real.log a ≥ Real.log b := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h
          have h₃ : a - b ≥ 0 := by linarith
          have h₄ : Real.log a - Real.log b ≥ 0 := by linarith

        ·

          have h₄ : a - b < 0 := by linarith
          have h₅ : Real.log a - Real.log b < 0 := by linarith

      exact h₁
    have h₂ : 0 ≤ (b - c) * (Real.log b - Real.log c) := by
      
      have h₂ : 0 ≤ (b - c) * (Real.log b - Real.log c) := by
        by_cases h : b ≥ c
        · 
          have h₃ : Real.log b ≥ Real.log c := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h
          have h₄ : b - c ≥ 0 := by linarith
          have h₅ : Real.log b - Real.log c ≥ 0 := by linarith
          nlinarith
        · 
          have h₃ : c > b := by linarith
          have h₄ : Real.log c > Real.log b := Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) h₃
          have h₅ : b - c < 0 := by linarith
          have h₆ : Real.log b - Real.log c < 0 := by linarith
          nlinarith
      exact h₂
    have h₃ : 0 ≤ (c - a) * (Real.log c - Real.log a) := by
      
      have h₃ : 0 ≤ (c - a) * (Real.log c - Real.log a) := by
        by_cases h : c ≥ a
        · 
          have h₄ : Real.log c ≥ Real.log a := Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h
          have h₅ : c - a ≥ 0 := by linarith
          have h₆ : Real.log c - Real.log a ≥ 0 := by linarith
          nlinarith
        · 
          have h₄ : a > c := by linarith
          have h₅ : Real.log a > Real.log c := Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) h₄
          have h₆ : c - a < 0 := by linarith
          have h₇ : Real.log c - Real.log a < 0 := by linarith
          nlinarith
      exact h₃
    
    have h₄ : 0 ≤ (a - b) * (Real.log a - Real.log b) + (b - c) * (Real.log b - Real.log c) + (c - a) * (Real.log c - Real.log a) := by
      linarith
    have h₅ : (a - b) * (Real.log a - Real.log b) + (b - c) * (Real.log b - Real.log c) + (c - a) * (Real.log c - Real.log a) = 2 * (a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c) - (a * Real.log b + a * Real.log c + b * Real.log a + b * Real.log c + c * Real.log a + c * Real.log b) := by
      ring_nf

      simp [mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
      <;>
      ring_nf
      <;>
      linarith
    have h₆ : 2 * (a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c) - (a * Real.log b + a * Real.log c + b * Real.log a + b * Real.log c + c * Real.log a + c * Real.log b) ≥ 0 := by
      linarith
    have h₇ : 3 * (a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c) ≥ (a + b + c) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
      nlinarith [h₆]

    have h₁ : Real.log (a ^ a * b ^ b * c ^ c) = a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c := by
      have h₂ : Real.log (a ^ a * b ^ b * c ^ c) = Real.log (a ^ a) + Real.log (b ^ b) + Real.log (c ^ c) := by

        rw [Real.log_rpow ha]
      have h₄ : Real.log (b ^ b) = b * Real.log b := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow hb]
      have h₅ : Real.log (c ^ c) = c * Real.log c := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow hc]
      rw [h₃, h₄, h₅]
      <;> ring
    have h₂ : Real.log ((a * b * c) ^ ((a + b + c) / 3)) = ((a + b + c) / 3) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
      have h₃ : Real.log ((a * b * c) ^ ((a + b + c) / 3)) = ((a + b + c) / 3) * Real.log (a * b * c) := by
        rw [Real.log_rpow (by positivity)]

        have h₅ : Real.log (a * b * c) = Real.log (a * b) + Real.log c := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        rw [h₅]
        have h₆ : Real.log (a * b) = Real.log a + Real.log b := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]

    have h₃ : a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c ≥ ((a + b + c) / 3) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by

          linarith

theorem usa2011_p4 :
